theme_scores.justification: The lines 'It will be reviewed' and 'If applicable, set review date: 10/2021' give no detail on success measures, testing, or evaluation methods.

reasoning: The extract provides only two sparse lines: 'It will be reviewed' and 'If applicable, set review date: 10/2021'. These statements gesture vaguely at a future review but do not specify what will be measured, what outcomes count as success, whether testing will occur before rollout, or how evaluation will be conducted. There is no mention of consultation plans, no timetable beyond a single tentative date qualified by 'If applicable', and no indication of what will happen to any results or whether they will be published. This falls short even of level 1, which requires 'some indication of success measures' - here there are none at all, only a bare promise of review. The strongest point in favour of any credit is the presence of a review date, which shows minimal forward planning, but this is undermined by the conditional phrasing 'If applicable', suggesting even the review itself is not certain. To reach level 1, the document would need to state at least some concrete success measures or outcomes to be tracked. To reach level 2, it would need to explain the process for developing such measures and detail testing or evaluation plans, or justify their absence. Given the near-total absence of substantive content, this section reads as if the evaluation plan exists elsewhere but was not captured here, or was never developed in the source document.
